description: This file defines a sealed trait and several case classes for managing AWS credentials within Spark Streaming Kinesis integration. It includes implementations for default, static, and STS-based credentials, along with a builder pattern for constructing credential instances.

classes.name: SparkAWSCredentials
classes.description: A sealed trait representing different AWS credential providers for Spark Streaming Kinesis.

classes.name: DefaultCredentials
classes.description: A singleton object providing default AWS credentials via DefaultCredentialsProvider.

classes.name: BasicCredentials
classes.description: A case class for static AWS credentials using access key ID and secret key.

classes.name: STSCredentials
classes.description: A case class for credentials obtained by assuming an IAM role via STS.

classes.name: SparkAWSCredentials.Builder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing instances of SparkAWSCredentials with various configurations.

methods.name: provider
methods.description: Returns an AwsCredentialsProvider instance for authentication.

methods.name: basicCredentials
methods.description: Sets static AWS credentials with access key ID and secret key.

methods.name: stsCredentials
methods.description: Configures STS to assume an IAM role for temporary credentials.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the appropriate SparkAWSCredentials instance based on configuration.

methods.name: builder
methods.description: Creates a new Builder instance for SparkAWSCredentials.
